title: 第二十八章 碎石第二十九章 巧合
slug: 我都成超人了灵气才复苏
content_zh:
夜空，月朗星稀。
“呼——”
陈洛走出城中村，迎面便是冷风吹拂。
他长吁一口气，脑海中的眩晕彻底消散。
得益于联邦前些年发布的政策。
现在，即便到了深夜，依旧会有夜班公交车运行。
陈洛环视四周。
视线锁定不远处，马路边上的公交站台，当即迈步走去。
二十分钟后。
伴随一阵剧烈抖动。
陈洛坐在侧边车位，看着窗外景色缓慢移动。
他的脑海里，莫名又回荡起李怀山的呜咽，以及埋头颤抖的悲哀模样。
李怀山是自作自受吗？
陈洛觉得是的。
对方年轻时不顾妻儿，只沉迷练武比试，试图战胜一个个所谓的宗师名宿，来证明自己的能力。
最后落得这个下场，或许是时代不容，或许是命运弄人。
但总归，是咎由自取。
但李怀山，完全是错的吗？
陈洛又觉得不是。
对方若早出生个数百年，数千年，乃至上万年。

在那些，个人武力依旧还有价值的年代，他或许能闯下赫赫威名，成就一番功绩。
【时代不同了，大人】
陈洛脑子里，没由来地冒出这么一句话。
他无聊时刷手机，总能在那些枪械相关的视频下，看到这么一句调侃。
是的，时代不同了。
单纯的个人武力，在热武器面前不值一提，更无法发挥出什么有效的价值。
唯有结合人脉、机遇、名声等等其他事物，将其转化具体的财富与权力，才能做到改变生活，提高自己的生活地位。
想到这里。
他看向自己手腕处的圆环。
陈洛不禁扪心自问。
自己，是不是在走李怀山的老路？
哪怕依靠着词条，一步步增强自己的实力。
最后，
还是只能行走于法规之内，在热武器的威慑下夹起尾巴做人。
要么，彻底掩藏自己的力量，做个普通安生的小市民。
要么，就利用自己的优势，去直播，去拍电影，去打比赛，去结交达官显贵。
要么，就有可能落到和李怀山一样的境地？
这种生活，未免太过无趣。
content_en:
In the night sky, the moon is bright and the stars are sparse.
"Huh——"
Chen Luo walked out of the village in the city, facing the cold wind.
He took a long breath, and the dizziness in his mind completely dissipated.
Thanks to the policies issued by the federal government in previous years.
Now, even late at night, there are still night buses running.
Chen Luo looked around.
His eyes locked on the bus stop on the side of the road not far away, and he immediately walked towards it.
Twenty minutes later.
Accompanied by a violent shaking.
Chen Luo sat in the side parking space and watched the scenery outside the window move slowly.
In his mind, Li Huaishan's sobs and the sad look of his head trembling were echoed inexplicably.
Did Li Huaishan bring it upon himself?
Chen Luo thinks so.
When the other party was young, he ignored his wife and children and only indulged in martial arts competitions, trying to defeat the so-called masters and celebrities to prove his ability.
In the end, I ended up like this, maybe because the times did not allow it, or maybe it was fate.
But in the end, it’s your own fault.
But was Li Huaishan completely wrong?
Chen Luo thought otherwise.
If the other person had been born hundreds, thousands, or even tens of thousands of years earlier.
In those days when personal force was still valuable, he might be able to achieve great fame and achieve great achievements.
[Times have changed, my lord]
Such a sentence popped up in Chen Luo's mind for no reason.
When he was bored and scrolling through his phone, he would always see such a joke under those videos related to firearms.
Yes, times have changed.
Pure personal force is not worth mentioning in the face of hot weapons, let alone can exert any effective value.
Only by combining connections, opportunities, reputation and other things and transforming them into concrete wealth and power can you change your life and improve your status in life.
Think of this.
He looked at the ring on his wrist.
Chen Luo couldn't help but ask himself.
Are you following Li Huaishan's old path?
Even if you rely on the entries, you can enhance your strength step by step.
Finally,
Or we can only walk within the regulations and behave with our tail between our legs under the threat of hot weapons.
Or, completely hide your own power and become an ordinary and peaceful citizen.
Or, use your own advantages to live broadcast, shoot movies, play games, and make friends with dignitaries.
Or, is it possible to end up in the same situation as Li Huaishan?
This kind of life is too boring.
